title: MXene quantum dots for geochemical ion sensing: mechanism-driven design of integrated platforms

MXene quantum dots (MQDs) enable ultrasensitive ion sensing via engineered surface terminations, defect states, and charge-transfer pathways, detecting toxic metals and oxyanions while enabling sensing-remediation.
